description: VIVI MUSIC v6.0.8.2 brings in-playlist song suggestions and YouTube automix recommendations with audio preview, full Spotify push and sync overhaul, typo-tolerant fuzzy settings search with sentence casing, persistent Home feed caching, and expanded section layout.

changelog.title: What's New
items: Live search suggestions and audio preview in in-playlist Add Songs dialog
Similar song recommendations (From playlist) powered by YouTube automix radio engine
Push local playlists directly to Spotify account with selection sheet, duplicate prevention, and live progress dialog
Typo-tolerant Levenshtein fuzzy search for Settings with word substring and description matching
Sentence casing standardization across all settings headers and labels
Persistent in-memory Home feed caching to eliminate reload spinners when switching tabs
Expanded vertical spacing between Home feed sections for a cleaner, spacious layout
In-playlist Add Songs menu moved exclusively to playlist three-dots menu
Multi-select support on artist pages (preview songs, library songs, and online songs)
Automatic background lyrics pre-fetching when playing songs online
Two-way Spotify sync and fixed playlist creation on Spotify profile
Optimized download engine with 512KB CDN range chunking and automated stream search fallback
Fixed offline thumbnail caching with persistent OkHttp cache and headers override
Fixed offline playlist truncation glitch
Refined player action button bounds
Implemented full Android System UI playback resumption (Spotify-style persistent widget)
Added dormant Quick Settings media panel pinning on OnePlus / OxygenOS
Added automatic queue restoration from disk & database on playback resumption
Added SponsorBlock
Added new UI to Listen Together
Added new Player v17 (portrait only)
Added new miniplayer
Added new setting screens
Added new Remix section in home screen
New UI for search screen
Added search history box inside search bar
Added Unison lyrics provider
Added new login method by SchmidtiTv (new commit)
Added missing View Album
New account setting UI
Added expressive UI to album image
Added Data Saver

changelog.title: Fixes & Improvements
items: Fixed swiped-away media widget dismissal by correctly detaching foreground notification on task removed
Fixed MediaLibraryService intent filter actions for MediaBrowser / System UI discovery
Removed SimpMusic lyrics provider
Improved Musixmatch lyrics (by johnpetersa19)
Fixed Spotify login
Fixed artist video rendering
Fixed streaming issues thanks to Metrolist
Spoofed app to browser for streaming safety
Updated strings by michel Mickael81
Updated Turkish translation by hasanbkaylan
Added complete Brazilian Portuguese translations by johnpetersa19
Under the hood performance improvements
